title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves subtracting the mean of each column from the respective column values, except for the intercept column. This ensures that the mean of each column is zero.

title: Effect of Mean-Centering on Fitted Values
text: When data is mean-centered, the intercept term in the linear regression model represents the mean of the response variable. This means that the mean of the fitted values will equal the mean of the observed values.

title: Mean of Fitted Values
